scope: small one-seed engineering pilot, not final benchmark

config.supervision: uniform distinct GT predicates per pair; soft-target CE; duplicates carry no extra train weight
config.sampling: all positive pairs + up to 3x backgrounds; no-GT images up to 32 backgrounds; zero-pair images no loss
config.topology: all directed pairs without self edges; GAT adds self loops internally; never GT relations
config.selection_metric: validation GC mR@50 over all pinned predicates, earliest epoch on tie

gc.absent_predicates_in_mean: zero; all pinned foreground predicates remain in denominator

ng.absent_predicates_in_mean: zero; all pinned foreground predicates remain in denominator
